name: Run interactive game simulations and structured RPGs
description: Users asked the AI to act as a Game Master or narrator for complex, structured role-playing games and simulations. These requests frequently involved detailed world-building, specific game mechanics like dice rolls or resource management, and strategic decision-making within high-fantasy, geopolitical, or game-based settings.
